Remark
[Weyl tensor]

Source: petersen:page-0128 ↗ rem:pet-ch3-ex-24

1. ch3:3.4.25Define $W$ implicitly by $R=\dfrac {\operatorname {scal}}{n(n-1)}g\owedge g+\dfrac 2{n-2}(\operatorname {Ric}-\tfrac {\operatorname {scal}}ng)\owedge g+W=P\owedge g+W$ (with $P$ as in section 3). (1) Show $n=3$ implies $W=0$. (2) Show $\sum _iW(X,E_i,E_i,Y)=0$ for any orthonormal frame $E_i$. (3) Show the decomposition $R=P\owedge g+W$ is orthogonal.
